verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox for building and testing without affecting live production data. It has its own frontend (demo.ramp.com) and API base (demo-api.ramp.com), no real money movement, and a demo actions panel for simulating events. The AI-native tooling targets it directly: the CLI connects to the sandbox by default, and a separate demo MCP endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com) serves demo data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox endpoints work as documented (no probe exercised demo-api or demo-mcp).
